method.resampler: zero-phase Hann-windowed sinc; radius 48 input samples; zero extension; DC weight normalization
method.amplitude: original PCM full-scale units; no peak normalization
method.markerWindows: fixed original machine-estimated markers in every rate; overlapping and edge windows excluded

limits: Four clips are engineering checks, not a generalization benchmark.
Markers are machine-estimated transients; window overlap checks cannot certify isolated biological clicks.
Whole-clip spectra also depend on rhythm and background. Event summaries use fixed original marker windows.
Sample rate sets a representable ceiling, not a measured recording bandwidth. Resampling cannot restore absent information.
Timing uses equal-count normalized interval MAD; spectrum uses L1 distance of four mean event band-energy fractions within each rate. No combined score.
Nearest marker displacement is an engineering diagnostic, not verified event correspondence.
